speaker: Imani Reed
text: I retract my claim that the ferry office signed a free-fare agreement for tenants. I have seen no signed agreement. I do not retract my October 5 count of 17 broken approach lamps.

speaker: Dana Vale
text: My September 14 reference to 1,240 workers was wrong. The team counted 1,240 boardings, not unique workers. I stand by the boarding tally, but repeat trips remain undeduplicated.

speaker: Municipal clerk Elin Moss
text: The November 2 committee record supersedes the proposed November 16 pilot date with a conditional December 7 target. No permit has been issued.

speaker: Newsroom facilities desk
text: The office kettle inventory wrongly listed three kettles. There are two. This is an internal kitchen correction unrelated to the ferry.
